records.name: Tidewell Slump
records.biography_en: One wave arrived on time and the other claimed it was on the wrong coast. Tidewell declined to choose.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: One wave arrived on time and the other claimed it was on the wrong coast. Tidewell declined to choose.

records.name: Ada Ashpuff
records.biography_en: Her eruption was classed as minor because it occurred during a major apology.

records.name: Pim Noonshade
records.biography_en: He claimed the disc had no back. I spent the afternoon proving him half right.

records.name: Tess Sheerair
records.biography_en: She peeled the weather off in one piece. Underneath it was pleasantly local.

records.name: Bram Stoneear
records.biography_en: The geode asked for a private word. Bram heard enough to wish it had stayed a mineral.

records.biography_en: North left abruptly. West said this had been building for years.
